Bitcoin may hit $100k by year-end: BitGet. Trump may pass Bitcoin Act: CoinShares. Uyeda may replace Gensler at SEC. Lummis backs BTC as National Reserve asset. Tether bridges $2bn to ETH network. ETH ICO investor transfers $39.4mm to Kraken. DeFi coins outperform, ENA proposes fee swap. JPM allows instant FX settlement on blockchain. BNB allows tokenisation platform. CryptoCom plans stablecoin in 2025. Arkham launches perp futures exchange. AVAX buys $52m tokens from Luna Foundation. DOGE flip over XRP only brief. WLFI fails to see bounce in funding after election.

entry.title: US Election Day, Large ETF outflows, FWOG hits $380M!

Michigan Pension Fund buy ETH ETFs. ETH is Amazon 2.0: 21 Shares. Deutsche Telekom pilots BTC mining scheme. Tether denies plan for blockchain. Citi, Fidelity unveil tokenized FX swaps. Bitget introduces Bitget Pay. a16z send another $23m to crypto PAC. Binance & CZ attempt to squash SEC suit.

entry.title: BTC dips below $69K, Cobie’s Bullish message, GOAT rebounds above $500M
entry.summary: BTC falls below $69k as Trump’s odds fall. BTC volatility points to ±10% move on election. BTC to $50k if Harris, $80-90k if Trump: Bernstein. We are going to $100k BTC no matter what: Cobie. 21Shares applies for XRP ETF. Singapore pushes for RWA tokenisation rules. UBS launches tokenised fund on ETH. Circle explores issuing stablecoin in Hong Kong. Tether launches Dirham stablecoin on TON. $2.8bn of altcoin unlocks this month. Tron makes 2nd highest ever monthly revenue. SOL saw 120m active addresses last month. EIGEN hits lows as ETH researchers leave. Coinbase called out for zero listing fee claim. Binance earlier accused of wanting 15% for listings.
